extraction_warnings: Paper reports aggregate group-level data (n=15 for Yanomami/Brazil) but does not provide individual subject or sample IDs. Sample-level extraction reflects that metadata applies to all samples collectively.
Age and sex data are mentioned as 'acquired' and referenced in Supplementary Table 1, but individual values not provided in the main text.
Paper compares multiple groups (Yanomami/Brazil n=15, Yanomami/Venezuela n=8, Matses n=24, Tunapuco n=12, US n=44) but this extraction focuses on the primary Yanomami/Brazil cohort.
No individual participant IDs or sample accessions are provided in the accessible text; BioProject accession PRJNA527208 is the study-level identifier.
Batch 1 returned granularity='study_level', differs from batch 0 ('sample_level'); kept batch 0.

This study focuses on gut microbiome characterization in a healthy hunter-gatherer population (Yanomami). The schema fields are predominantly designed for clinical/oncology studies and are largely not applicable to this observational microbiome research.
